title: MA60077: Computer Programming
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Programming preliminaries, some simple programs in C, numeric constants and
variables, arithmetic expressions, input and output, conditional statements,
loops, arrays, logical expressions, functions, character strings, enumerated
data type and stacks, structures, pointer data type, lists and trees,
recursion, bit level operations, files in C, miscellaneous features of C.
